purpose: Bind the owner-observed Compass regressions and corrected opening architecture into mandatory construction context before any further public Compass repair.
precedenceLaw: This amendment is additive and corrective. Where construction-execution-plan.v2.json can be read to permit the observed regression, this amendment controls. It does not erase preservation, authority, navigation, accessibility, Mirrorland, Fibonacci, or bounded-claim requirements in v2.

visitorLanguageLaw.required: Explain what is here, what the visitor can do, why it matters, and where a destination leads in concrete public language.
visitorLanguageLaw.law: Technical language may appear only where it earns visitor understanding or bounded proof; it may not carry the primary orientation burden.

openingCorrection.relationship: Diamond Gate Bridge is the estate being introduced; Compass is the instrument used to understand and navigate it.
openingCorrection.law: Collapsed may reduce depth but may not mean context absent. The visitor must understand the premise of Diamond Gate Bridge before choosing to expand.

coupledSpatialExplanation.stateLaw: Rotation changes the paired explanation. Foregrounding a room changes its visible identity, practical meaning, and action availability in the paired surface.

roomIdentityAndStateLaw.secondaryLabels: Every navigable secondary room must retain an accessible visible identity sufficient to understand the cluster without experimental selection.
roomIdentityAndStateLaw.clusterRotation: As each room star becomes foregrounded, the contextual surface must immediately become that room's preview before selection.
roomIdentityAndStateLaw.roomPreview: Show room name, concrete purpose, useful orientation, and no Enter action.
roomIdentityAndStateLaw.roomSelected: Selection commits that same room identity and exposes the correct room-specific Enter action.

proportionalEmphasisLaw.required: Emphasis must be earned compositionally through typography, light, depth, motion, shimmer, controlled animation, responsive interaction, distinctive JavaScript behavior, or other authored treatment appropriate to the feature.
proportionalEmphasisLaw.prohibited: Do not translate importance primarily into oversized rectangular containers, excessive viewport consumption, or repeated large editorial cards.

progressiveDisclosureLaw.law: More explanatory text may not reduce immediate navigational comprehension. The page must become easier to learn by using it.

qualificationAmendment.law: Technical Playwright green is insufficient. Exact-candidate qualification must include display-fidelity regression assertions and downstream visual/perceptual adjudication when the universal stack provides them.
qualificationAmendment.ownerInspectionLaw: Owner-observed regressions are evidence to correct and bind; screenshots are not a required pre-merge approval gate unless explicitly requested.
